# BigQuery documentation examples, rounded to millimeters to allow floating-point differences.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md

SELECT ROUND(ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), directed => TRUE), 3)
=> "1688933.983"

SELECT ROUND(ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), directed => TRUE), 3)
=> "5802892.745"

SELECT ROUND(ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), directed => FALSE), 3)
=> "5802892.745"

SELECT ROUND(ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)')), 3)
=> "5802892.745"

# NULL propagation and zero distances follow the documented definition.

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 3 0, 0 3, 0 0))'), directed => TRUE)
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), directed => TRUE) < 0.000001
=> "true"

# BigQuery observations: empty and full inputs, and optional argument boundary behavior.

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), directed => TRUE)
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), directed => NULL)
=> null
